provenance.name: anchored-v2
provenance.note: Provisional anchoring to the published results of another machine (round robin 2022/2023, Bosch SMV6ECX51E, eco programme, detergent D; docs/research/standards.md section 7.1), to be replaced by washes on the owner's machine. Made on the water side "spotless-sim 0.3.2 water-3", sources sha256:97aa4d392843040da01252e2c616e5b0bced8cb5f608159e7aff197d8bab94d5; it is valid for that water side only (anchors/scripts/check.ts compares). Mechanism corrections (not fitted): soil.subCellCv = 0.3, soil.loadScale = 0.002, soil.amountCv = 0.05, soil.heatDryingFactor = 80, soil.heldFilmCapacity = 0.02, soil.tea.visibleFraction = 0, soil.tea.visibleMass = 0.00005. Fitted to the six in-machine egg-yolk rates (soils 6.1): soil.egg_yolk.rateRef = 0.0000354. Searched against the class means of the record from its default to 0.02 (milk case "film", level seeds 1 2, simulation seeds 1 2): liq.xProtease, best 0.02, kept (its default costs 0.66 log units). At their defaults, not searched: soil.bleachRate, soil.supplyRenewal. See docs/calibration/anchoring.md.
